The user says: "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. They likely want to run a command to start Docker. But Docker is a service; you can start it via Docker Desktop or via Docker Engine. The command "docker start" is used to start containers, not the Docker daemon. To start Docker service, you might use "net start com.docker.service" or "Start-Service Docker" in PowerShell. Or if using Docker Desktop, you can start the Docker Desktop application.

Or "docker-machine start default" if using Docker Machine.
